node.statement: Case m = 1: by the raw-call hypothesis the old side is absent, so the asserted sum map is exactly the supplied fresh extended t-inclusion C^2 -> S_{P_fresh} contained in A; since C^2 = C^{m+1}, t <= D_1*t, and defect-parameter monotonicity applies, this is the required extended D_1*t-inclusion, with the conclusion precisely the supplied fresh inclusion.
